My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
• Just now
I'm sorry to hear that your item arrived damaged. Here's what you should do:
Document the Damage:
Take photos of the damaged packaging itself, especially if it shows signs of potential product damage
Take clear photos of the entire product and close-ups of the affected areas
Include a common object near the damaged area to show scale
If the item has a law tag with a barcode, photograph both the front and back
Contact Our Support Team:
Once you have the photos, please reach out to our support team with:
Your order details and email address
The photos and description of the damage
Your current shipping address
The team will review your documentation and guide you through the next steps. Processing time for replacement requests may take up to 7 business days, not including any production time needed to make the replacement item.
If the item qualifies for a replacement due to a manufacturing or shipping issue, the team will arrange that for you. You can continue using the item while waiting for the replacement if needed.
